about.what: Measured outcomes of `grasppanda compose` + `grasppanda probe` for the grid of grasppanda.combine.grid. No number here is an accuracy; see docs/advanced_guides/measured_combinations.md.

verdicts.runs: On real frames: the detector was built, every requested training iteration ran with finite losses and at least one real seed, the weights stayed finite, and prediction returned valid grasp groups for every probed frame.
verdicts.runs-unstable: On real frames: training and prediction ran to the end, but a loss or a weight became non-finite, or an iteration had no real seed (no scene point passed the proposal, so only the proposal was trained), or no iteration supervised a seed.
verdicts.fails: An exception was raised after the config check had passed. The report names the phase (build, data, optimizer, loss, backward, step, hook, predict), the component it came from and the message.
verdicts.refused: The config check refused the config (the same check as `grasppanda print-config --check --for train`). Nothing was built; the report carries the messages.
verdicts.wired: No real frame was read. On a synthetic table-top scene with random labels the detector was built, back-propagated a loss through every stage and predicted. This shows that the stages connect; it says nothing about real data.

fields.group: reference, encoder, stage, stage-set or family (grasppanda.combine.grid)
fields.method: the method whose shipped config the cell starts from
fields.sets: the slot=choice pairs of the compose request; absent for a config as shipped
fields.slot, component, variant: for encoder and stage cells: the replaced slot, the component type put there, and its preset (or the type again, for constructor defaults)
fields.config_hash: first 16 hex digits of the hash of the composed config; null when the config check refused it
fields.compose: the command that wrote the config; absent for a config as shipped
fields.probe: the command that probed it. Run after `compose` in the same directory it repeats the cell
fields.probed_as: the cell whose probe this cell shares: both composed to the same config (the same hash), which was probed once. The numbers are in that cell
fields.adapter: the encoder adapter compose inserted, when it did
fields.fitted: options compose set to fit the method, beyond copying a preset
fields.refusal: the messages of the contract rules and of the config check, whole
fields.failure: phase, component, exception and message of a failure after the check passed
fields.parameters, iterations, batch_size, fram: what the probe built, trained on and predicted
fields.losses: every loss term at the first and the last iteration, four significant digits
fields.real_seeds, supervised_seeds: minimum and mean over the iterations of the fraction of seed slots with a real seed and of seeds that took part in the grasp losses, and the number of iterations at zero
fields.shared_machine: seconds per iteration, peak GPU memory (MiB) and wall time of the probe (s): numbers that depend on the load of the machine
fields.run: the run that measured the cell (about.runs): date, commit and environment

about.scale_statistic: Configs that read the width histogram of Scale-Balanced-Grasp were probed with the reference's own file (`scale_statistic.source: legacy_import`, the SHA-256 in the probe command): the native histogram is a statistic of a whole training split, and a probe reads eight frames.
about.shared_machine: `shared_machine` holds seconds per iteration, peak GPU memory and wall time. They were measured while other jobs used the same GPU and CPUs, with as many probes at a time as the run says: an order of magnitude, not a benchmark.
